name: M.D. Integrations Connect
author: M.D. Integrations

sections.description:
1. Configure your MDI credentials.
  2. Connect to MDI and give us access to your account.
  3. Follow the steps to link you store to MD Integrations panel.

External services

This plugin connects to the MD Integrations API to obtain your credentials, your offerings, your Store data and other informations we need to provide you our platform experience, it’s needed to integrate your store to our medical platform.

It sends cart and customer information every time the checkout is finished. It creates MDI Vouchers where your customer will be able to access it and fill out an intake form to then be eligible to receive medical care.
This service is provided by “MD Integrations Inc.”: terms of use, privacy policy.
sections.installation: Once you have it installed you will see a menu on the left side where you will be able to see all necessary steps to link you store to MDI.
